name: claude-mem — Persistent Context Across Sessions
hook: 89.8K stars, updated Aug 5. Captures everything Claude does across sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context automatically into new sessions via lifecycle hooks — no manual context management. Uses a three-layer progressive-disclosure architecture (search → timeline → fetch) that cuts memory token overhead by ~10x vs naively injecting full history. Works with Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Gemini CLI.

name: oh-my-openagent — Multi-Agent Orchestration for Complex Codebases
hook: 67.4K stars, updated Aug 6. Deploys up to 8 parallel Claude agents with distinct roles — Sisyphus (orchestrator), Hephaestus (autonomous worker), Prometheus (strategic planner) — with real-time tmux visualization and hash-anchored edits that prevent stale-line bugs. The `ultrawork` command activates the full fleet and runs until task completion. Supports multi-model routing across Claude, GPT-5.6, Kimi K3, and Gemini.
